goal.en: Talk about finished past events: was/were, regular -ed verbs, and past questions.
goal.ar: أن تتحدث عن أحداث انتهت في الماضي: was/were، والأفعال المنتهية بـ ed، والسؤال في الماضي.

text.en: was = I, he, she, it. were = you, we, they. Negative: wasn't / weren't.
text.ar: نستخدم was مع I/he/she/it، وwere مع you/we/they. والنفي wasn't وweren't.

text.en: Most verbs add -ed: worked, played, watched. Verbs ending in -e add only -d (liked). Consonant + y → -ied (studied).
text.ar: أغلب الأفعال تأخذ ed مثل worked. وما ينتهي بـ e يأخذ d فقط مثل liked. وy المسبوقة بساكن تصير ied مثل studied.

text.en: The past form is the same for every subject: I worked, she worked, they worked. No -s, no changes.
text.ar: صيغة الماضي واحدة لجميع الضمائر: I worked وshe worked وthey worked، فلا s ولا تغيير.

text.en: -ed has three sounds: /t/ in worked, /d/ in played, /ɪd/ in wanted. Listen for them.
text.ar: تُنطق ed بثلاث طرق: /t/ في worked، و/d/ في played، و/id/ في wanted.

text.en: Questions and negatives use “did” + the BASE verb: Did you watch the film? I didn't watch it.
text.ar: السؤال والنفي في الماضي يستخدمان did مع الفعل المجرد: Did you watch…? / I didn't watch it.

text.en: The past is marked once only. “Did you watched?” and “I didn't went” are wrong — the -ed disappears after did.
text.ar: علامة الماضي تظهر مرة واحدة. فلا نقول Did you watched ولا I didn't went، بل Did you watch وI didn't go.

items.en: Did she call you? — Yes, she did.

questions.sentence: They ___ very happy with the result.

explanation.ar: أداة السؤال ثم were ثم الفاعل.
y المسبوقة بساكن تتحول إلى ied.
حدث منتهٍ في الماضي، فنستخدم closed.

options: We watched a film last night.

explanation.en: The past form never takes -s: they played.
explanation.ar: صيغة الماضي لا تأخذ s أبداً. الصواب they played.

explanation.en: Past question with an action verb → Did.
explanation.ar: السؤال في الماضي مع فعل عادي يبدأ بـ Did.

explanation.en: After didn't, use the base verb: didn't watch.
explanation.ar: بعد didn't يأتي الفعل مجرداً: didn't watch.

commonMistake.en: Marking the past twice (didn't watched) is the most frequent past-tense error.
commonMistake.ar: تكرار علامة الماضي مرتين أشهر خطأ في هذا الزمن.

prompt.en: “Did they arrive on time?” — Choose the correct short answer.

questions.answer: When did you start your job

explanation.en: Question word + did + subject + base verb.
explanation.ar: أداة السؤال ثم did ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل المجرد.

options: Did you were at the party?

explanation.en: Do not use “did” with “was/were”. Ask “Were you at the party?”
explanation.ar: لا نجمع did مع was/were. الصواب Were you at the party?

prompt.en: Match the verb with its past form.

explanation.en: Spelling rules: double the consonant (stop), add -d (like), -y → -ied (try).
explanation.ar: قواعد الإملاء: مضاعفة الساكن في stop، وإضافة d في like، وتحويل y إلى ied في try.

prompt.en: Put into the past: “They live in Beirut.”
prompt.ar: حوّلها إلى الماضي: They live in Beirut.

explanation.ar: الفعل live ينتهي بـ e فنضيف d فقط.

questions.sentence: I ___ the email, but I ___ an answer.

explanation.en: Positive past = past form (sent); negative = didn't + base (get).
explanation.ar: الإثبات يأخذ صيغة الماضي sent، والنفي يأخذ didn't مع الفعل المجرد get.

questions.sentence: There ___ a lot of people at the wedding.

explanation.en: “A lot of people” is plural → there were.
explanation.ar: «الكثير من الناس» جمع، فنستخدم there were.

questions.sentence: Last summer we ___ in Alexandria and ___ every morning.

explanation.en: Both actions are finished past events; “swim” is irregular (swam) — you will meet more irregular verbs in A2.
explanation.ar: الحدثان انتهيا في الماضي. ولاحظ أن swim فعل شاذ فماضيه swam، وستدرس الأفعال الشاذة في المستوى A2.
